title: War Thunder
source: discovered 2026-10-20 on 11 WT DVR recordings (40 bursts x 4 frames, 129 gameplay frames), calibrated by hand
notes: killfeed: right edge above the minimap; rows 'Actor (Vehicle) -> weapon -> Target (Vehicle)', stacking upward from y~644, ~22 px apart; long entries wrap into an actor row and a victim row. AI targets (Assault) are a bare red vehicle name. Discovery proposed 1356,540 564x168; extended up to y 430 for 5-6 entries and stopped above the minimap grid labels (y~690).

Text colours: own name gold/orange, squad green, allies blue/purple, enemies red. Weapon text is grey or yellow, so colour is only used to split an unparenthesised target; who killed whom comes from position.

awards: death screen ('You have been destroyed by X (vehicle)', 'Crew knocked out' at y~290-360) and award/streak popups ('Base capturer streak x2!', 'Zone captured' at y~190-270). Discovery: notice 372,204 840x216.
messages: capture/objective messages ('Our team is capturing zone A.', 'The enemy is capturing our base!') at y~860-930. Discovery: notice2 492,756 792x216.
Player names are not stored in presets: set your in-game name(s) in config.json "player_tags" (or pass --player). Your own name is drawn gold/orange.
